title: Mixed fact and dimension responsibilities in one table
rationale: Tables that mix filtering/grouping attributes with transactional facts can reduce model clarity and optimization potential.
review_note: Valid for very small/simple models or deliberate denormalization.

title: Inconsistent fact table grain
rationale: Fact rows should represent a consistent grain; mixed grain can produce incorrect aggregations.
evidence_required: Fact table keys, sample rows, measure behavior
review_note: May be intentional only when explicitly modeled and documented.

title: No dedicated date dimension where time intelligence is material
rationale: A dedicated date dimension improves consistent filtering, time intelligence and maintainability.
evidence_required: Date columns, marked date table, relationships
review_note: Not required when the report has no meaningful date analysis.

title: Excessive snowflaking in semantic model
rationale: Long relationship chains and many small dimension tables can reduce usability and sometimes performance.
evidence_required: Model graph, table sizes, relationship chains
review_note: Some normalized structures are justified by reuse or scale.

title: Large unused columns retained in model
rationale: Unused columns increase model size and can increase refresh/query cost.
review_note: Keep columns needed for RLS, relationships, sort-by, or hidden technical logic.

title: High-cardinality text columns loaded without clear analytical need
rationale: High-cardinality columns can increase VertiPaq memory footprint.
review_note: May be required for drill-through, detail tables or identifiers.

title: Implicit measures used for business-critical KPIs
rationale: Explicit measures improve governance, reuse and consistent KPI logic.
review_note: Implicit measures are acceptable for ad-hoc/simple reporting.

title: Calculated columns used where a measure or Power Query transformation is more appropriate
rationale: Calculated columns consume model storage and may be unnecessary when logic can be evaluated at query or refresh time.
review_note: Calculated columns are valid when row-level persisted values are needed.
